name: Evaluation Report to Parents
description: Completed special education evaluation report, with test results, summaries, identified needs and recommendations for the IEP team.
deadline: no later than 60 calendar days after receipt of written consent (excluding summer break)
quote: The evaluation shall be completed and a copy of the evaluation report presented to parents/guardians no later than sixty (60) calendar days after receipt of written parent/guardian consent for an evaluation, exclusive of the period following the last day of the spring school term to the first day of the subsequent fall term.
